en: Black‑and‑white elevated view over a small European town in a hilly rural landscape. Compact multi‑story houses with steep gabled roofs cluster in a valley, surrounded by dense trees, gardens, and terraced fields or vineyards on the slopes. At lower right, commercial buildings line a street; one facade carries large painted signage. In the far background are gently rolling fields and scattered farm buildings. There is no visible postcard caption or decorative framing, just the photograph itself.
